issues.explanation: No test files are included in the diff for any new behavior, despite the task spanning models, policies, pick endpoint, and three Livewire components.
Public inputs email, name, slug and targetMembershipId have no #[Validate] attributes; actions use inline $this->validate([...]) instead of the required #[Validate] + validate pattern.

Each Livewire component keeps a locked boundEntityId but also exposes an unlocked entityId and Entity model that carry the same server context and are never used for authorization, violating lock-server-context.
Docs updated only for database-schema.md; no CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased as required by keep-docs-in-sync.
Triple storage of boundEntityId plus entityId plus Entity model, and duplicated lang keys entity_welcome/dashboard_welcome and owner_notice/entity_owner_notice, add unused state.
Public entityId is written in mount but never read; render and actions reload from boundEntityId, leaving dead state for future maintainers.

conventions.evidence: Uses policies, #[Locked] boundEntityId, Blade components and audit channel correctly, but misses #[Validate] on email/name/slug (Members.php:118, Settings.php:269) and leaves unlocked entityId/entity alongside locked boundEntityId; no CHANGELOG update.

readability.evidence: Small focused methods and clear names (membership(), entity(), transfer()), but dead public $entityId written in mount and never read obscures which id is authoritative.

requirements.evidence: entities_slug_unique with SoftDeletes (migration 2026_10_29_000000), owner_seq storedAs plus entity_memberships_one_owner (migration 000001), Entity/Membership/UserRole contract, EntityPolicy/EntityMembershipPolicy, entity.pick audit+403, Dashboard/Members/Settings mount+actions, routes /e/{entity:slug}[/membros|/settings|/pick], lang nav_members/nav_settings and owner/transfer strings all present.

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves task.md (models, migrations, factories, policies, controller, Livewire, views, routes, langs, database-schema.md); no onboarding, switcher, locale middleware, navbar, billing or queue work added.

security.evidence: All entry points authorize (Controller abort_unless membership; mount view/manageSettings; addMember/assignRole update, removeMember view+delete, save/delete/transfer manageSettings) with entity-scoped lookups aborting 403 and {{ }} escaping; only gap is unlocked redundant $entityId/$entity which are never used for decisions.

simplicity.evidence: Direct Eloquent + policies with no service layers; minor duplication only: boundEntityId/entityId/entity triple and duplicate ui keys entity_welcome vs dashboard_welcome.

tests.evidence: change.diff contains zero test files; no Pest/PHPUnit coverage for happy paths, validation failures, unauthorized calls, or tamper attempts required by conventions.

review.summary: Implements the full entity data model, one-owner invariant, policies, pick endpoint, and Dashboard/Members/Settings pages correctly and securely via the locked boundEntityId. Missing all required tests blocks merging, with #[Validate] and unlocked redundant entity state needing cleanup.
